April 18, 2018 - By Dolores Ford 
Oracle Investment Management Inc increased its stake in Contrafect Corp (CFRX) by 32.92% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Oracle Investment Management Inc bought 718,385 shares as the company’s stock rose 45.45% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 2.90 million shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.93 million, up from 2.18M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Oracle Investment Management Inc who had been investing in Contrafect Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $120.06M market cap company. The stock increased 5.16% or $0.08 during the last trading session, reaching $1.63. About 103,961 shares traded. ContraFect Corporation (NASDAQ:CFRX) has declined 21.95% since April 18, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 33.50% the S&P500. 
Levy Harkins & Company Inc increased its stake in Apple Inc. (AAPL) by 17.29% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Levy Harkins & Company Inc bought 29,252 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The hedge fund held 198,454 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $33.58 million, up from 169,202 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Levy Harkins & Company Inc who had been investing in Apple Inc. for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $904.39B market cap company. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since April 18, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.

The rating was downgraded by Roth Capital to “Neutral” on Tuesday, May 10.
